sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000088-P1, was presented by SANOFI (the Supplier) to Keystone Community Health 088 on April 3, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 2 rebate of 3%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 1,030 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
